scope: The actual normalized Haar-cap Wilson law is identified exactly with the unrestricted fixed-exterior interior Gibbs measure conditioned on its chord event. Gibbs tilting and event conditioning commute with the true partitions retained; the finite product of normalized Haar caps maps to the conditioned product Haar measure. Event reference mass is nonzero for positive radius. The law of total covariance over an event is proved, including zero-mass event or complement cases: Cov=p*Cov_good+delta*Cov_bad+p*delta*(mean_good_F-mean_bad_F)*(mean_good_G-mean_bad_G). For sources bounded in absolute value by two, the complement and between-event terms cost at most 4*delta+16*p*delta. Therefore a proved capped covariance bound B transfers to the unrestricted interior as p*B+4*delta+16*p*delta, and hence B+20*delta. The literal two-source Wilson instance has B=8*|S|*log(81)/(beta-1), and the additionally transported source instance has denominator beta-2 with overlap allowed. Their prior small-background hypotheses remain unchanged; delta is the actual probability of the cap complement under the matching full sourced interior law, not an assumed small parameter. A separate exact spatial disintegration retains the genuine exterior marginal weighted by the full interior partition, and the covariance of the conditional exterior responses. Combining this with event conditioning gives the full unrestricted middle covariance and then the exact connected boundary quantity at depth j+1 as the retained endpoint average of the capped/complement/between-event contribution plus spatial exterior response covariance, followed by the propagated endpoint response covariance. No exterior field is removed from these identities. Small complement probability, coverage by eligible backgrounds, spatial decay and both retained covariance bounds are unproved. The distant mixed-ground sum, independent global lower coercivity, physical scaling and continuum construction remain open, as do all twelve full Clay requirements.

actual_objects.interiorLaw: The full sourced Gibbs law on all interior Haar coordinates with the exterior fixed.
actual_objects.event: Each active link is in its closed chord cap about the supplied center.
actual_objects.p: Actual interior Gibbs probability of the cap event.
actual_objects.delta: Actual interior Gibbs probability of the cap complement; p+delta=1.
actual_objects.outsideLaw: The original full-slice Gibbs marginal on exterior coordinates, retaining the entire interior partition.
actual_objects.endpoint retainedLaw: The existing joint middle/end-point marginal with spatial weight, propagated message and sourced middle partition.

proved_results: Gibbs tilting commutes exactly with conditioning on a positive reference-mass event.
The product cap reference and its full Wilson tilt push forward to the corresponding conditional interior law.
The exact event covariance identity retains both within-event terms and the covariance of the two conditional means, also when an event has zero probability.
For absolute source bounds two, unrestricted interior covariance <=p*B+4*delta+16*p*delta<=B+20*delta.
The literal two-source Wilson interior bound has B=8*|S|*log(81)/(beta-1); the transported extra-source bound has denominator beta-2.
The full middle covariance equals the exterior average of the exact event contribution plus the actual exterior-response covariance.
The distant connected boundary quantity at depth j+1 equals the endpoint average of this full middle expansion plus the retained endpoint-response covariance.
next_attack: Control the actual cap-complement and ineligible-background contributions in the same response-weighted norm, with an admissible patch covering.
Derive spatially decaying patch response and bound the retained spatial exterior covariance; the extensive fluctuation estimate alone does not propagate decay.
Control the retained endpoint-response covariance through its actual source hierarchy, preserving every message and partition.
Use verified separation decay to supply the dyadic far-sum premise and then prove the independent global lower coercivity and physical scaling obligations.
not_inferred: All twelve full Clay requirements remain open; no continuum Yang-Mills construction or uniform physical mass gap is proved.
The cap-complement probability is now bound to the actual unrestricted sourced interior Gibbs law. It has not been proved small, uniformly or in the required response-weighted energy.
The two-source and extra-source covariance transfer bounds keep their prior base hypotheses. Eligible small backgrounds have not been shown to cover the full retained exterior law.
The local bound grows with patch cardinality and contains no spatial-separation decay. It does not establish the dyadic far-sum premise.

The exact distant covariance retains two separate terms: spatial exterior-response covariance inside each middle bridge, and propagated endpoint-response covariance. Both remain quantitatively uncontrolled for the required contraction.

The spatial marginal retains its full interior partition. The endpoint law retains its spatial weight, boundary message and sourced middle partition; no uniform comparison eliminating these has been proved.
These covariance upper bounds do not establish the independent global lower coercivity inequality, including the center-even physical sector.
Existing ground-averaged bad-bridge tails do not automatically bound this matching cap-complement probability or remove defective directions from coercivity.
A suitable physical overlap margin, controlled coupling/time scaling, reflected compactness and nonzero continuum survival remain open.
No Balaban block-RG construction, gauge-covariant localized inverse estimate, or full physical clustering theorem is claimed.
